_doc: Stake approval checklist (plan Factory v3, D2). Evaluated by tools/release/checklist.py into build/<id>/reports/stake_checklist.json (StakeChecklist, factory/src/lib/types.ts). verify: auto = checked from files, e2e = Playwright result (build/<id>/reports/e2e.json, else the gate.json e2e step), manual = a person looks; 'look' says what to look at. 'evidence' is the check key in checklist.py. Numeric ids are guideline ids of the Stake AI-review prompt (texts are short paraphrases; full wording at the source URL).

items.text: Authenticates with the RGS on launch.
items.look: Open the game from the Studio: it loads past the loading screen with a balance.

items.text: Fails correctly with an invalid rgs_url.
items.look: Open with rgs_url=bad.host: a plain connection message, no raw JSON, no endless loader.

items.text: Pressing bet sends a successful play request.
items.look: Press Spin: /wallet/play returns 200 and the round plays.

items.text: No Stake Engine loader.
items.look: The loading screen is the game's own.

items.text: Title is unique and avoids restricted terms (Megaways, XWays, Enhanced, Boosted, RTP, Gates of, Bonanza, Olympus, Rush, Kraken, Waylanders).
items.look: Search the Stake lobby for the title: no existing game with the same name.

items.text: No offensive or inappropriate content (no child-like art, mature theme).
items.look: Look at every symbol, background and win screen: nothing offensive or child-like.

items.text: Distinct from existing titles.
items.look: Compare theme, art and mechanics with Stake's top slots and our own games: clearly different.

items.text: Uses every bet parameter from authenticate (bet levels, min, max, per-mode maxBet).
items.look: Step through bet levels: they match the Studio bet-level template.

items.text: An active round restores its bet amount.
items.look: Reload during a bonus: it resumes with the same bet.

items.text: Supports and displays currencies correctly.
items.look: Open with currency=EUR, JPY, BTC: symbol, decimals and placement correct.

items.text: Sub-cent payouts display correctly.
items.look: At the lowest bet a 0.2x win shows its sub-cent digits.

items.text: Zero-win rounds send no end-round request.
items.look: Browser network tab: a losing spin sends /wallet/play only, no /wallet/end-round.

items.text: Insufficient balance sends no play request.
items.look: Set a bet above the balance and press Spin: a message, no /wallet/play request (game/actor.ts guard).

items.text: Space bar places a bet.
items.look: Press Space on the main screen: a round starts.

items.text: Main frame doesn't scroll.
items.look: At 1024x576, 400x225, 800x450 and 425x812 the page has no scrollbar and cannot be scrolled (the e2e baselines compare the viewport only; they do not measure scrolling).

items.text: Autoplay needs a confirmation step.
items.look: Open Auto spin: rounds start only after an explicit confirm.

items.text: High-cost modes (bonus buys) need confirmation.
items.look: Buy a bonus: a confirm dialog with the price appears first.

items.text: Sound can be turned off.
items.look: Menu > Sound: all sound stops, and the setting sticks.

items.text: RTP and max win are stated (game and every mode), matching the math.
items.look: Game rules screen: RTP and max win per mode.

items.text: Every symbol's payout is shown.
items.look: Pay table screen: every pay symbol with its pays.

items.text: Win combinations are explained (clusters, scatter, multipliers, wild).
items.look: Game rules screen: how a win forms and what each special symbol and multiplier does.

items.text: Every mode has a description and cost.
items.look: Bonus menu and rules: every mode has a title, a description and its price.

items.text: Free games and re-triggers are explained.
items.look: Game rules screen: how free spins start, how many, and how re-triggers add spins.

items.text: Every control is explained.
items.look: Game rules > Buttons: every on-screen button is listed.

items.text: General disclaimer is present.
items.look: Game rules > General: the Engine disclaimer text.

items.text: Mystery Mode chances are accurate.
items.look: Only for games with a Mystery mode: stated chances equal the math.

items.text: Works on laptop 1024x576.
items.look: Open at 1024x576: every control visible and usable, nothing overlaps the board.

items.text: Works in popout S 400x225 and L 800x450.
items.look: Open at 400x225 and 800x450: every control usable.

items.text: Works on mobile 425x812.
items.look: Open at 425x812: every control usable, the WIN label does not cover the board.

items.text: Double-tap zoom is disabled on mobile.
items.look: On a phone, double-tap the board: no zoom.

items.text: English is supported (no raw keys, undefined or NaN in texts).
items.look: Read every screen in English: no keys like mode.x.title, no 'undefined'.

items.text: Invalid languages don't break the display.
items.look: Open with lang=xx and lang=en_US: English, no console errors.

items.text: Social mode: all text uses social wording.
items.look: Open with social=true: read the rules, bonus menu and errors for bet, buy, pay, cash, stake.

items.text: Social mode: SC and GC currencies, no '$'.
items.look: Open with social=true&currency=XSC: amounts end in SC, no $.

items.text: Social mode: mode names use social wording.
items.look: Bonus menu with social=true: no 'buy' or 'bet' in mode names.

items.text: The replay has no restricted words.
items.look: Open a replay with social=true: no restricted words.

items.text: Replay URLs load and play the event.
items.look: Open a reviewer event ID replay link: the round plays.

items.text: Optional replay parameters (amount, currency, lang, social) are applied.
items.look: Replay link with amount=2&currency=EUR&lang=en: the bet shows EUR 2.00.

items.text: The replay can be watched again.
items.look: After a replay ends, press REPLAY: it plays again.

items.text: Bet cost and multiplier are shown in the replay.
items.look: Replay of a bonus buy: the real cost (bet x mode price) and the win multiplier are shown.

items.text: Replays work at popout S (400x225).
items.look: Open a replay at 400x225: it plays and the replay controls fit.

items.text: Critical: the cheapest mode costs 1.0x.
Critical: every 1.0x mode has a standard deviation of at least 0.6.
Critical: every mode's RTP is between 96.0% and 96.7%.
Critical: max win at most 1,000,000x.
Critical: every mode costs at most 50,000x.
Books payouts match the lookup tables.
Critical: the modes fit the chosen bet-level template.
items.look: Studio > Math > Publish: the bet-level template check is green for every mode.

items.text: Non-critical: hit rate 1 in 50 or better.
Non-critical: max win more often than 1 in 10,000,000.
Non-critical: 100,000 to 1,000,000 simulations per mode.
Non-critical: no failed risk classes (volatility, CVaR, ETL, tail probability); each failed class lowers exposure and bet limits.
The game is stateless: every result comes from the RGS, nothing is decided in the browser.
items.look: Architecture: results come only from books via /wallet/play (core/web, docs/03).

items.text: Original game: own art, sound and design, no copied IP.
items.look: Every asset has a licence or is our own work (Asset desk provenance).

items.text: No Stake branding or logos in the game.
items.look: Look at the loading screen and menus: no Stake or Engine logo.

items.text: No web-sdk sample assets.
items.look: Gate step 'no sample assets' passes.

items.text: No requests to hosts outside the bundle and rgs_url.
No visual bugs (overlaps, cut-off text, flicker, missing images).
items.look: Play 50 spins and one bonus per mode at each reviewer size.

items.text: Balance and the final win are always shown.
items.look: After every round the HUD shows the new balance and the round's total win.

items.text: The win counts up to the final payout.
items.look: A big win: the counter rises to the exact final amount.

items.text: In fast play (turbo) wins stay legible.
items.look: Turn on turbo: every win amount is readable before the next round.

items.text: No console or network errors.
items.look: Browser console during play and replay: no errors, no failed requests.

items.text: prefers-reduced-motion starts in turbo (unless the jurisdiction disables turbo).
Tile sources exist: 3:4 background, 3:4 transparent foreground, 16:9 cover.
Tile (3:4) and cover (16:9) made in the Studio Media Editor.
items.look: Studio > Media: both crops saved.

items.text: Tiles are bright and well lit.
items.look: Tile next to the Stake lobby: it is not darker than its neighbours.

items.text: No dark edges or vignette on the tiles.
items.look: The tile's borders are as bright as its centre.

items.text: No extra text on the tiles (only the title).
items.look: No taglines, RTP, 'new' badges or provider text on the tile.

items.text: The title sits inside the safe area.
items.look: Media Editor safe-area overlay: the title is fully inside it in both crops.

items.text: Review: 3 reviewers rate 0-3 stars each; the game needs at least 6 of 9 points to publish, else the review thread locks for 3 days. Only top-rated (3 of 3) games reach New Releases, Slots and Burst Games.
items.look: Aim for 3 stars: original art, polish, every item above green.
